name: developer
description: The development loop end to end: implement a feature in verifiable slices, refactor without changing behaviour, diagnose a bug to its proved root cause, fix it with the failing test first, bisect a regression to the commit that caused it, run the repo's checks, then ship it as a ticket, branch and PR. Use when asked to implement, refactor, debug, fix a failing or flaky test, find what broke, or open a PR.
